lines.text: Four years in a kitchen drawer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So who's had it all this time?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Americans are sitting on about $27 billion in unused gift cards.
lines.spoken: Americans are sitting on about twenty-seven billion dollars in unused gift cards.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And stores get to keep the part we forget.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Starbucks booked $188 million of it in one year.
lines.spoken: Starbucks booked a hundred and eighty-eight million dollars of it in one year.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the rules are on your side. Full case, linked below.
